title: Vaultwarden

tagline.en: Password manager, compatible with Bitwarden apps
tagline.es: Gestor de contraseñas compatible con las apps de Bitwarden
tagline.fr: Gestionnaire de mots de passe compatible avec les applis Bitwarden
tagline.pt: Gestor de senhas compatível com as apps do Bitwarden
tagline.ja: Bitwarden アプリと互換のパスワードマネージャー
tagline.ru: Менеджер паролей, совместимый с приложениями Bitwarden
tagline.hi: पासवर्ड मैनेजर, Bitwarden ऐप्स के साथ संगत

notes: One named /data volume preserves SQLite, attachments and the RSA session-signing keypair; losing it loses every vault.
The first visitor registers. ADMIN_TOKEN is deliberately unset: an unrequested admin panel is a worse default than none.
The latest tag tracks Bitwarden client compatibility.
